notes: Checked: main header mega-menu (site-nav dropdowns + mobile slide-nav), homepage hero/footer banners, full /collections.json sweep (270 collections), sitemap_collections_1.xml, robots.txt (clean). Clearance is a genuine, explicitly-labelled nav concept on this site: a top-level main-nav item literally titled 'Clearance: FLAT 50% OFF' (69 products) expands into a dropdown of 5 per-category 'Clearance Offer X <category>' pages, which are real site-exposed children -- recorded as a group (row 2) plus its 5 leaves (rows 3-7). Verified the 5 X-category product sets are pairwise disjoint from each other (zero overlap between any two), but their union (86 products total) does NOT exactly equal the parent 'Clearance: FLAT 50% OFF' set (69 products: 66 shared, 20 appear only in the X-category pages, 3 appear only in the parent) -- each page's own qty is independently verified exact against its own /products.json enumeration and on-page count text, so all 6 qtys stand as reported even though the parent is not a strict numeric superset of its children. A separate, older page simply titled 'Clearance' (handle clearance-sale, 21 products) also exists -- its own <title>/og:title/H1 all read 'Clearance', a clean taxonomy signal -- but it is not in the main nav; its only surfaced on-site placement is a homepage footer promo banner (see flag on row 1). It is NOT an alias of the nav clearance pages (only 19/21 of its products overlap with 'Clearance: FLAT 50% OFF', 18/21 overlap with the X-category union), so it is kept as a separate row per the genuinely-different-listing rule. Excluded after inspection as generic temporary promotions carrying no Clearance/Outlet/Final Sale/Last Chance/End of Line wording: CRED Offer tiers, Diwali Offer tiers, Summer Sale family, Valentine's Day Sale family, Freedom Sale, Rakhi Special, Art Bash family, Friday Deals/Sales family, Shop Under X price tiers, Gift For Her/Him, Cred Reward tiers, BOGO / Buy 1 Get 1 Free. No 'Outlet', 'Final Sale', 'Last Chance', or 'End of Line' named page exists anywhere on the site.
